description: Moves a practice lead through its follow-ups, as the Practice mode controls do, so you can see what Sergio would do at the next moment. action is one of: next (jump to the lead's next scheduled moment: a queued send, a step coming due, going cold), wait (days of silence pass first, 1 to 60), run (run whatever is already due now), start_over (a fresh practice lead arrives with this lead's first message). Only a practice lead is accepted; nothing is sent to a real person. task_id is the lead (read entity tasks). Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying. An owner-level change: Sergio tells the owner after it is made.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

reason.description: Why you are doing this, in one sentence. The owner sees it in the notice Sergio sends after the change.

name: practice_lead
title: Move a practice lead through time
